987.skill_description: The improvement and summary stage in behavioral therapy; through administering the SCL-90, SDS, and SAS again and comparing with before treatment for assessment, combining follow-up tracking, strengthen the learned relaxation and positive cognition, consolidate symptom improvement, and prevent relapse.

988.skill_description: During the consolidation stage, continuously Reinforcing positive cognitions and self-suggestion, Relaxation training, consolidating changes like ‘no longer fearing communication, facing exams with equanimity’, enhancing confidence and adaptability, promoting more stable and mature personality.

989.skill_description: Through re-testing SCL-90, SAS, SDS and comparing with pre-treatment results, monitoring symptom reduction and functional Recovery; combining follow-ups and consolidation practice, maintaining continuous Anxiety and depression reduction, improving overall psychological health.
